name: Create a QDoc
description:
This design models UC-1, Create a QDoc, in a green field: a quality manager creates a QDoc, the QDoc gets a document number and version 1, and every quality manager is told.

# Where it lands

- [qdocmanagement](noesis:module|qdocmanagement) is the new root; each module under it is one subsystem of the QDoc System.
- [preparation](noesis:module|qdocmanagement.preparation) creates the QDoc and its first version ([Start a QDoc](noesis:need|start-a-qdoc), [Ready to write](noesis:need|ready-to-write)).
- [notifications](noesis:module|qdocmanagement.notifications) delivers messages for the other subsystems ([Know about new QDocs](noesis:need|know-about-new-qdocs)).

# Where to start reading

1. [QDocCreationService.createQDoc](noesis:behavior|qdocmanagement.preparation.QDocCreationService.createQDoc) runs the use case. It rejects a requester who is not a quality manager (SR-PRE-001), takes a number from [DocumentNumberGenerator](noesis:building_block|qdocmanagement.preparation.DocumentNumberGenerator) (FR-PRE-009), creates the QDoc, saves it and publishes [QDocCreated](noesis:building_block|qdocmanagement.preparation.QDocCreated) in one unit of work, and asks Notifications to tell every quality manager (FR-NOT-001).
2. [QDoc](noesis:building_block|qdocmanagement.preparation.QDoc) is the aggregate: active when created (FR-PRE-003), never without a version (FR-PRE-010). [QDoc.create](noesis:behavior|qdocmanagement.preparation.QDoc.create) makes it together with its first version.
3. [Version.createFirst](noesis:behavior|qdocmanagement.preparation.Version.createFirst) makes version 1 with the status new, one empty [ContentFile](noesis:building_block|qdocmanagement.preparation.ContentFile) and an [Assignment](noesis:building_block|qdocmanagement.preparation.Assignment) for each person the request names (FR-PRE-004 to FR-PRE-008).
4. [NotificationService.notifyUsers](noesis:behavior|qdocmanagement.notifications.NotificationService.notifyUsers) sends one [Notification](noesis:building_block|qdocmanagement.notifications.Notification) per recipient through [NotificationSender](noesis:building_block|qdocmanagement.notifications.NotificationSender); a failed delivery stops no other. It knows nothing of QDocs: Preparation finds the quality managers through [IdentityProvider.findQualityManagers](noesis:behavior|qdocmanagement.preparation.IdentityProvider.findQualityManagers) and builds the [NewQDocNotification](noesis:building_block|qdocmanagement.preparation.NewQDocNotification).

# Around them

- The request is the [CreateQDoc](noesis:building_block|qdocmanagement.preparation.CreateQDoc) command: a title, a document type and at least one author, with reviewers and approvers optional (FR-PRE-001, FR-PRE-007, FR-PRE-008).
- Value objects hold the closed lists: [DocumentType](noesis:building_block|qdocmanagement.preparation.DocumentType) (FR-PRE-002), [QDocStatus](noesis:building_block|qdocmanagement.preparation.QDocStatus), [VersionStatus](noesis:building_block|qdocmanagement.preparation.VersionStatus) and [AssignmentRole](noesis:building_block|qdocmanagement.preparation.AssignmentRole); a [QDocTitle](noesis:building_block|qdocmanagement.preparation.QDocTitle) is never blank.
- Ports and storage: [IdentityProvider](noesis:building_block|qdocmanagement.preparation.IdentityProvider) to the Identity subsystem, [PreparationEventPublisher](noesis:building_block|qdocmanagement.preparation.PreparationEventPublisher) for events, [QDocRepository](noesis:building_block|qdocmanagement.preparation.QDocRepository) for whole QDocs.

# Left for later

- The document number's format, sequence and uniqueness: UC-2.
- Checks on the people assigned: UC-3; until then they are assigned as given.
- Editing, history and comments of content files: UC-4.
- The notification channel and its maximum delay: TBD-01.

statement.value: The quality managers need to start a QDoc in the QDoc System when the organisation decides the QDoc is needed, naming the authors who will write the QDoc.
statement.author: agent

statement.value: The quality managers need to learn of each QDoc another quality manager creates.
statement.author: agent

statement.value: The authors need a version with a content file to write in from the moment the QDoc exists.
statement.author: agent

definition.value: The QDoc System: supports organisations in preparing, approving, distributing and acknowledging quality documents (QDocs) and keeps the record of who did what and when. Each child module is one subsystem and one bounded context.
definition.author: agent

diagram.value:
flowchart LR
  accTitle: Subsystems taking part in creating a QDoc
  QM([Quality manager]) -->|createQDoc| PRE[preparation]
  PRE -->|notifyUsers| NOT[notifications]
  NOT -->|notification| QMs([Each quality manager])
diagram.author: agent

definition.value: Bounded context of the Preparation subsystem (area code PRE): creates and numbers QDocs and versions, assigns people, holds the files of a version, shares versions for review, records review marks, creates new versions and archives QDocs.
definition.author: agent

definition.value: Bounded context of the Notifications subsystem (area code NOT), a platform subsystem and an open host: tells users what the other subsystems ask it to tell them, such as a new QDoc, a new version or an assignment. Holds no process of its own and knows nothing of the subsystems that call it.
definition.author: agent

definition.value: Identity of a QDoc inside the QDoc System. Technical identifier, not the document number people use.
definition.author: agent

definition.value: Identity of a user, a person with an account in the identity provider. The Preparation subsystem refers to users only by this identity.
definition.author: agent

definition.value: The title of a QDoc.
definition.author: agent

definition.value: The type of a QDoc, one of the list of document types: procedure, guideline, instruction, policy. The list may grow.
definition.author: agent

definition.value: The human-facing identifier a QDoc gets at creation, for searching and for referring to the QDoc. Not a security device.
definition.author: agent

definition.value: The status of a QDoc itself: active or archived. Workflow statuses belong to versions, not to the QDoc.
definition.author: agent

definition.value: The workflow status of a version: new, approved, published, no longer in force or archived.
definition.author: agent

definition.value: The role a user holds on a version: author, reviewer or approver.
definition.author: agent

definition.value: The link between a user, a version and one role the user holds on the version.
definition.author: agent

definition.value: Identity of a content file.
definition.author: agent

definition.value: Command: a quality manager's QDoc creation request, naming the title, the document type, at least one author and, optionally, reviewers and approvers.
definition.author: agent

definition.value: Event: a QDoc was created. Published by the Preparation subsystem for any subsystem that follows new QDocs.
definition.author: agent

definition.value: A rich-text file the authors write; the body of a QDoc version. Each version has at least one. Its editing, change history and comments belong to the Content management subsystem.
definition.author: agent

definition.value: A complete, self-contained edition of a QDoc, numbered from 1. Carries the workflow status, the content files and the assignments of people.
definition.author: agent

definition.value: A quality document: a package of files that always works as a whole. Has a title, a document type, a document number and one or more versions; is either active or archived.
definition.author: agent

diagram.author: agent

definition.value: Stores and loads QDoc aggregates, whole.
definition.author: agent

definition.value: Gives a new QDoc its document number, and owns the rules by which document numbers are composed, sequenced and kept unique.
definition.author: agent

definition.value: Port to the Identity subsystem, or to a directory the organisation runs: answers which roles a user holds and which users hold the quality manager role.
definition.author: agent

definition.value: Port that publishes the events of the Preparation subsystem to the other subsystems.
definition.author: agent

definition.value: Use cases that create QDocs in the Preparation subsystem.
definition.author: agent

definition.value: A user a notification goes to, by the user's identifier in the identity provider.
definition.author: agent

definition.value: The message telling the quality managers about a new QDoc: names the QDoc, its document number and its creator, and gives the subject and the body the Notifications subsystem is asked to deliver.
definition.author: agent

definition.value: Command: a request from another subsystem to tell users something, naming the recipients, a subject and a body. The requesting subsystem chooses the recipients and writes the text.
definition.author: agent

definition.value: A message to one user: a subject and a body, as the requesting subsystem wrote them.
definition.author: agent

definition.value: Port that delivers a notification to a user.
definition.author: agent

definition.value: The service the Notifications subsystem offers every other subsystem: takes a request to tell users something and has a notification delivered to each of them.
definition.author: agent

definition.value: Creates a QDoc on a quality manager's request: gives it a document number, starts its first version with the people the request names, announces the new QDoc to the other subsystems and has every quality manager told of it.
definition.author: agent

diagram.value:
sequenceDiagram
  accTitle: Creating a QDoc
  actor QM as Quality manager
  QM->>QDocCreationService: createQDoc(command)
  QDocCreationService->>IdentityProvider: isQualityManager(requestedBy)
  QDocCreationService->>DocumentNumberGenerator: next()
  QDocCreationService->>QDoc: create(command, number)
  QDoc->>Version: createFirst(authors, reviewers, approvers)
  QDocCreationService->>QDocRepository: save(qdoc)
  QDocCreationService->>PreparationEventPublisher: publish(QDocCreated)
  QDocCreationService->>IdentityProvider: findQualityManagers()
  QDocCreationService->>NotificationService: notifyUsers(NewQDocNotification for the quality managers)
  QDocCreationService-->>QM: QDocId
diagram.author: agent

added.id: rule|qdocmanagement.preparation.A creation request names a title, a document type and at least one author

name.value: A creation request names a title, a document type and at least one author
name.author: agent

description.value: A QDoc creation request that lacks the title, the document type or at least one author is rejected (FR-PRE-001). Reviewers and approvers are optional.
description.author: agent

rationale.value: These three are the checks made before a QDoc is created; reviewers and approvers may be added later (UC-3).
rationale.author: agent

added.id: rule|qdocmanagement.preparation.A QDoc keeps at least one version

name.value: A QDoc keeps at least one version
name.author: agent

description.value: Every QDoc holds at least one version at all times (FR-PRE-010); no operation leaves a QDoc with zero versions.
description.author: agent

rationale.value: A QDoc without a version has nothing to review, approve or publish.
rationale.author: agent

description.value: A QDoc creation request from a user who lacks the quality manager role is rejected (SR-PRE-001). Authors, reviewers, approvers and auditors create nothing. The requester's roles are those held at the moment of the request.
description.author: agent

rationale.value: Creating a QDoc is a quality manager's decision. An auditor has read-only access (SR-ACT-002) and creates nothing.
rationale.author: agent

added.id: rule|qdocmanagement.preparation.A new QDoc carries a document number

name.value: A new QDoc carries a document number
name.author: agent

description.value: Every QDoc gets its document number when it is created (FR-PRE-009), from the DocumentNumberGenerator; the format is defined by UC-2.
description.author: agent

rationale.value: Each QDoc needs a number from the moment it exists, for searching and for referring to it.
rationale.author: agent

added.id: rule|qdocmanagement.preparation.A QDoc is saved and announced together

name.value: A QDoc is saved and announced together
name.author: agent

description.value: The new QDoc is saved and QDocCreated is published in the same unit of work: either both happen or neither does. A rejected request creates nothing and publishes nothing.
description.author: agent

added.id: rule|qdocmanagement.preparation.Each quality manager learns of a new QDoc

name.value: Each quality manager learns of a new QDoc
name.author: agent

description.value: When a QDoc is created, the Preparation subsystem asks the Notifications subsystem to notify each quality manager of the organisation, naming the QDoc, its number and its creator (FR-NOT-001). The quality managers are those holding the role at the moment the QDoc is created.
description.author: agent

rationale.value: The creation of a procedure matters to each quality manager, not only to the one who created it.
rationale.author: agent

description.value: A QDoc starts with the status active (FR-PRE-003).
description.author: agent

rationale.value: A QDoc itself has only two statuses, active and archived; workflow statuses belong to versions.
rationale.author: agent

added.id: rule|qdocmanagement.preparation.Version 1 starts with the status new

name.value: Version 1 starts with the status new
name.author: agent

description.value: Creating a QDoc creates its version 1, with the status new (FR-PRE-004).
description.author: agent

rationale.value: Creating a QDoc is creating its first version.
rationale.author: agent

added.id: rule|qdocmanagement.preparation.Version 1 holds one empty content file

name.value: Version 1 holds one empty content file
name.author: agent

description.value: Version 1 is created with exactly one content file holding no text, and no attachment (FR-PRE-005).
description.author: agent

rationale.value: Each version has at least one content file (UC-4); the authors fill the first one.
rationale.author: agent

added.id: rule|qdocmanagement.preparation.The named authors are assigned to version 1

name.value: The named authors are assigned to version 1
name.author: agent

description.value: Each author named in the creation request is assigned to version 1 as author (FR-PRE-006).
description.author: agent

added.id: rule|qdocmanagement.preparation.The named reviewers are assigned to version 1

name.value: The named reviewers are assigned to version 1
name.author: agent

description.value: Each reviewer named in the creation request is assigned to version 1 as reviewer (FR-PRE-007).
description.author: agent

rationale.value: Reviewers are optional and may be added now or later (UC-3).
rationale.author: agent

added.id: rule|qdocmanagement.preparation.The named approvers are assigned to version 1

name.value: The named approvers are assigned to version 1
name.author: agent

description.value: Each approver named in the creation request is assigned to version 1 as approver (FR-PRE-008).

rationale.value: At least one approver is needed only when the version is shared (UC-6), so naming none at creation is allowed.
rationale.author: agent

added.id: rule|qdocmanagement.notifications.Each named recipient receives the notification

name.value: Each named recipient receives the notification
name.author: agent

description.value: When a subsystem asks the Notifications subsystem to notify users, each recipient the request names receives one notification carrying the subject and the body of the request (FR-NOT-001).
description.author: agent

added.id: rule|qdocmanagement.notifications.A notification arrives within the maximum delay

name.value: A notification arrives within the maximum delay
name.author: agent

description.value: Each recipient receives the notification within the maximum delay of TBD-01 after the request (FR-NOT-001). The delay and the channel are not settled yet (TBD-01).
